title: Weil positivity on a window of width log 5: Lean formalization
description:
Lean 4 formalization of Weil positivity on a window of width log 5.

  • RHLog5Release.target_log5: for every nonzero complex C² function f supported in [-½ log 5, ½ log 5], the zero sum defining W(f,f) converges and Re W(f,f) > 0.
  • RHLog5Release.target_log5_uniform: there is c > 0 such that c ∫|f|² ≤ Re W(f,f) for all such f (c is not evaluated numerically).

The Lean sources of this version are byte-identical to those verified by the author with the Lean FRO comparator in an isolated environment (run rh0605/final-001); both the standard Lean kernel and the NanoDa kernel accepted both theorems with only propext, Classical.choice, and Quot.sound. The raw evidence and a script that checks it are included. This is not a review by the tool developers or any other organization, and the mathematics has not yet been reviewed by human experts. This work does not prove, and makes no claim about, the Riemann Hypothesis. Generative AI was used extensively; see the README.
